text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let's throw a party! We'll celebrate and 
celebrate Sei-chan, and give her a 
celebratory figure-four leglock, yes!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No, no, you take care of me all the time, 
after all. So this time, please allow me 
to invite you to a party I'm hosting.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, Sei-chan is inviting me? I'm honored♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Truth be told, my room is 
currently overflowing with gem-like 
vegetables sent from my family home.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
With just one bite, pure bliss will surge 
from your tongue straight through your 
entire body, no doubt about it. It is 
truly the supreme delicacy.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~! You're gonna treat us to that at 
the party-desu ka!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Alas. How dreadful it is that there is 
no one here to cook these vegetables up 
deliciously..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, poor vegetables... To end up never 
becoming the stars of the party~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aww, isn't there a brave hero somewhere 
who could magically transform all these 
vegetables into a delicious meal...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If that's the case, allow me to 
throw my hat into the ring.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget the master of extra spice, 
El! My secret Salsa Roja is about to 
breathe fire!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ohh~ How dependable. Please, go right 
ahead~ ...Preferably on the milder, 
sweeter side, if possible.
